nodes.label: Emblem KFV Freising
nodes.description: Combined emblem consisting of two heraldic shields side by side. Left shield: Bavarian coat of arms style with blue-and-white diagonal lozenges (Bavarian diamond pattern) in upper half, and red lower half bearing a crowned Moor's head (black profile with red crown) on the left and a white Tudor rose on the right — representing the Landkreis Freising district coat of arms. Right shield: Red shield with white fire-brigade symbols — a flaming torch at top center, a gear/wheel in the center, two crossed axes (fire axes) in saltire, and crossed trumpet/horn instruments below, representing the Kreisfeuerwehrverband (district fire brigade association). The overall emblem represents the Kreisfeuerwehrverband Freising (KFV Freising).

nodes.label: Landkreis Freising District Coat of Arms
nodes.description: Left shield of the combined emblem: upper half displays the Bavarian blue-and-white diagonal lozenge pattern; lower half is red with a black Moor's head wearing a red crown on the left side and a white five-petaled rose on the right side. This is the heraldic coat of arms for Landkreis Freising, Bavaria.

nodes.label: Kreisfeuerwehrverband Fire Brigade Shield
nodes.description: Right shield of the combined emblem: red shield background with white fire-brigade heraldic symbols including a flaming torch/grenade at the top, a cogwheel/gear wheel in the center, two crossed fire axes in saltire, and crossed bugles/horns at the bottom. These symbols are standard German fire brigade association heraldry representing the Kreisfeuerwehrverband (district fire brigade association).
